beats.label: Land at the service quay; establish the tide mark and exit route
A disconnected radio repeats your arrival words before you speak
In the dry gatehouse learn the pump bypass on a powerless model
Wade into the intake; read fresh footprints climbing out of the water
First keeper encounter; shut the sluice after watching its patrol
Latch the maintenance alcove; recover and discover a rescue call sign
Reroute the lower pump using the learned bypass
Falling water reveals crew harnesses chained to the stairs
Cross the exposed gallery while the keeper searches below
Seal the chart room; learn that the beacon summoned the drowned crew
Use the chart to choose a lens path that signals the living boat
Climb the drowned stair as the keeper follows the moving beam
Surge breaks the stair; use a practiced sluice to cut off pursuit
Secure the upper winch room; checkpoint and plan the final route
Practice rotating the lens shutter to open the roof access
Apply the shutter cycle with the keeper on the other side of the lens
Release the lens counterweight while retreating to the roof hatch
Counterweight pins the hatch; brief sheltered landing before roof exit
Choose the known rescue call sign and redirect the beam offshore
Keeper breaches the roof; follow the established tether to the boat
Sever the lit tether as the beacon turns toward you; escape the surge
Boat clears the tower; the radio finally answers in a living voice
Record the rescued crew name; lighthouse beam sinks below the water
